notes.title: UPDATE 1768
notes.notes:
Changes for Update 1768

[list]
[*] New Weapon added Flame Thrower
[*] New Weapon added Oil
[*] New Weapon added Smokescreen
[*] New Death Messages - Player willl know who killed him and how 
[*] New Kill Messages - Added information on who killed who
[*] New Powerup Ghost - Player is like a ghost for 10 seconds
[*] New Powerup Quad Damage - Weapons do 4 times more damage
[*] New Powerup Nito - Get full nitro on pickup
[*] Game ends at correct time after all players have reached the goal
[*] Players can now paint the car in the color they want
[*] All addons and updates to the cars now change the behaviour of the car as expected with additional, weight, armor, engine improvments and so on.
[/list]

As always, enjoy!

notes.title: UPDATE 1699 RELEASED!
notes.notes:
UPDATE 1699 CONTAINS THE FOLLOWING:

[list]
[*] Change between drift and non drift mode in Settings
[*] Updated Infernoz Arena with lava rivers
[*] Updated with a new network smooth syncing system for a silky smooth network experience
[*] AI racing and aggresiveness is improved by about 5-10%
[*] Camera sensitivity can be set
[*] Steering Sensitivity can be set
[*] Wheels return to original position whenever you change direction or release button
[*] Less time for camera to return to follow car position
[*] Improved steering control
[*] Race mode has less drift and drift help then Drift mode
[*] Drift settings are synced over the network
[*] AI Bots now randomise between drift and race mode
[*] Improved graphical quality on Meadowz
[*] Race now ends after 60 seconds has passed or all players have finished or are wrecked.
[/list]

Enjoy!
